name: Nuam S.A.
summary: Nuam S.A., a holding company, provides clearing and settlement services in Chile, Colombia, and Peru. The company offers post-trading services, such as clearing and settlement services, settlement of stock market transactions, registration service, transfer, administration, and custody of securities; services and products related to market information, including orders, matching or closing of operations, and statistics of traded assets, as well as databases, licenses, and reports.
